questions.insight: AI processing shown as subtle shimmer. Magic happening visually. Show the intelligence at work.

questions.question: Which agent is the 'face' of Notient?
questions.insight: Chief of Staff IS Notient. It orchestrates everything. The identity, not just an agent.

questions.question: First research feature to prototype?
questions.insight: Both together. Shadow Layers = metadata overlay. Vault Symbiosis = cross-note intelligence.

questions.question: Which phrase is most core?
questions.answer: SEQUENTIAL: Vaults breathe → Notes think → Knowledge evolves
questions.insight: Not parallel features but a PROCESS. Vault awareness enables note intelligence enables knowledge evolution.

synthesis: The tagline is a process: Vault awareness (breathing) enables Note intelligence (thinking) which produces Knowledge growth (evolution). Chief of Staff IS Notient's identity. Shimmer effects are the primary visual for 'alive' feel. Dev branch will prototype Shadow Layers + Vault Symbiosis together.
keyDecisions: Tagline is sequential process, not parallel features
Chief of Staff = Notient's identity (orchestrator is the product)
Dev branch prototypes: Shadow Layers + Vault Symbiosis
